build_rainbow_network: build a Rainbow network mapping states to value distributions with configurable atoms and layers
create_rainbow_agent: create a multiplayer Rainbow agent for the Hanabi Learning Environment with prioritized replay
build_target_distribution: build the target distribution for Rainbow distributional RL using projected value distributions
build_train_op: build the training operation for Rainbow with prioritized replay and softmax cross-entropy loss
project_distribution: project a batch of support-weight pairs onto a target support grid per Bellemare et al. 2017
